charts.title: TOI-6034 b: orbits around TOI-6034
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-6034's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-6034 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kanodia et al. 2024 (2024AJ....168..235K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KANODIA_ET_AL_2024): P 2.576184 d

charts.title: TOI-6034 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-6034 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (84, 85, 86) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 388076422, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 6-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
